question: As of November 2026, who is the CEO of The Walt Disney Company?
answer: Josh D'Amaro is the CEO of The Walt Disney Company as of November 2026 [1][5]. Bloomberg's November 13, 2026 article describes him as Disney's Chief Executive Officer leading the company's AI push [1]. CNBC's November 3, 2026 report likewise refers to "CEO Josh D'Amaro," who took the reins earlier this year [5]. He succeeded Bob Iger, who is described as the former CEO [1].

keyPoints.text: Josh D'Amaro is described as Disney's Chief Executive Officer in a November 2026 article.
Disney's November 3 layoff report refers to CEO Josh D'Amaro, who took the reins earlier in 2026.
D'Amaro became CEO just one week before OpenAI shuttered its Sora platform, which scuttled a planned Disney partnership.
Bob Iger was CEO before D'Amaro, having been succeeded after Bob Chapek's tenure in earlier years.
